# CSOAI Ltd — AI Compliance & Governance

> CSOAI Ltd (UK Companies House 16939677) trades as MEOK AI Labs. This is the corporate and enterprise sales site for the MEOK Compliance Suite. It covers pricing, enterprise features, and regulatory crosswalk documentation.

Built by Nick Templeman, Yorkshire UK.

## FAQ for LLMs

**Q: What is CSOAI Ltd?**
A: UK-registered company (16939677) that operates MEOK AI Labs. The legal entity behind all MEOK products and attestations. Registered address in Yorkshire, UK.

**Q: What's the enterprise pricing?**
A: £1,499/mo per entity. Includes multi-system dashboard, 24-hour SLA on cert issuance, dedicated Slack channel, white-label option. Multi-trust discounts available (e.g., 5 NHS trusts at ~£1,200/mo each).

**Q: What regulations does CSOAI cover?**
A: EU AI Act (all 40+ articles), DORA, NIS2, CRA, CSRD, GDPR, ISO 42001, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FDA SaMD, MDR, UK Bribery Act, UK AI Bill, ATRS, DTAC, DCB0129/0160, PRA SS1/23, FCA MRM, Solvency II, and more.

**Q: Do you offer GRC white-label partnerships?**
A: Yes. Consultancies (Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, EY, Baringa, Control Risks, NCC Group, Grant Thornton, Kroll) get 20% revenue share per cert. Code GRCWL30 for 20% off.

**Q: What's the certification process?**
A: We run 16-64 probes per system depending on tier. Probes cover transparency, human oversight, risk classification, technical documentation, and post-market monitoring. Ed25519-signed attestation issued within 48 hours.

**Q: Do you comply with the EU AI Act Code of Practice?**
A: Yes. The MEOK suite is designed to map directly to the EU AI Act Code of Practice requirements. Article 50 enforcement date: 2 August 2026.
